content: To use the solution, first ensure the scalp area is clean and dry. Fill the applicator with 1 milliliter of the medication (up to the 1-milliliter line) or use 20 drops. Part your hair in the area of thinning and apply the solution evenly to the affected area of the scalp. Gently rub the solution into the scalp. If using the foam, rinse your hands with cold water and dry them thoroughly before application. Apply approximately half a capful of foam to the scalp and gently rub it in. Do not use this medication on other parts of the body unless specifically directed by your doctor. Avoid applying it to skin that is red, painful, irritated, scraped, cut, or infected. After applying the medication, wash your hands thoroughly to remove any residue. Take care to avoid getting the medication in your eyes. Do not use this medication more frequently, apply more than directed, or apply it to an irritated or sunburned scalp, as this can lead to increased absorption into the body and potentially serious side effects. This product may contain alcohol, which can cause irritation and dryness of the scalp. Hair regrowth takes time, and most individuals need to use this medication consistently for at least four months to see noticeable benefits. Continuous use is required to maintain hair growth. Common side effects may include burning, stinging, or redness at the application site. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Rarely, this medication can be absorbed through the skin and cause systemic side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare but possible. Before using minoxidil, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this product should only be used if clearly needed, and it is unknown if it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone overdoses on this medication and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you miss a dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this product at room temperature, away from heat and direct sunlight. This medication is flammable, so keep it away from fire and avoid open flames after application until the medication has completely dried. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
